title: .respawnpack/runtime/index-owned-<sessionId>.json — which staged states this session put there
description: Written by hooks/_index-lease.js recordOwned(). GITIGNORED. Two levels: sha16(index identity) → repo-relative path → state key. ⛔ THE STATE KEY, NOT THE PATH, IS WHAT MAKES foreignStates() CORRECT (finding N-4): comparing raw command path text against the repository-root coordinates `git diff --cached` reports meant `git add -- A.txt` run in `sub/` read as no overlap with a foreign staged `sub/A.txt`. One canonical representation on both sides was the fix; more patterns was not.

additionalProperties.description: [status, dstMode, dstOid, path, from||''].join('|') — e.g. "M|100644|a1b2…|src/x.js|". Statuses come from `git diff --cached --raw -z`.
